summary: Iteration 11 verified Database Klien create/edit by Admin/Super Admin without a booking, plus audit log and UI. Backend 9/9 pytest in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration11.py pass: staff (Rina) -> 403 on POST /clients; Admin creates manual client (manual:true, total_bookings:0, appears in GET /clients); duplicate phone normalized (0812 vs 62812) -> 409; PUT /clients/{key} changes key when phone changes and old key returns 404; PUT unknown key -> 404; collision with another client's phone -> 409; editing a booking-derived client propagates new name/phone to ALL that client's bookings and the booking stays visible in client's history under the new key; GET /audit?entity=client (super admin) returns create+update actions with field diffs; /clients/export PDF+XLSX still 200. Frontend (390x844, Expo web): Admin 1 logged in via login-key-{d} testids, Lainnya > Database Klien shows clients-add-button; /client-form submits with client-{name,phone,instagram,address,notes}-input + client-save-button; after save routes to /client/{key} showing client-profile-card and client-no-bookings 'Belum ada booking untuk klien ini.'; header client-edit-button opens prefilled form; saving with changed phone updates detail (new phone visible). Rina (staff) does NOT see 'Database Klien' link in Lainnya at all (even stronger than hiding only the Tambah button) and therefore has no clients-add-button access. Super Admin > Riwayat Perubahan shows audit-filter-client chip; selecting it lists 'Klien baru ...' and 'Ubah data klien ...' entries with field diffs and actor name. Admin 1 PIN had drifted on the preview DB (direct curl 401); tester restored it to 111111 via Super Admin PUT /users/{id} before UI run.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py create_client/update_client correctly audit with field diffs; nice touch mapping internal fields to Bahasa Indonesia labels (Nama/No. WhatsApp/...).

client_key uses norm_phone which collapses 0812.. and 62812.. to the same key — dedup verified end-to-end. However client_key also falls back to a slug of client_name when phone is empty: creating two phone-less clients with the same name will 409 (expected) but creating two phone-less clients whose names differ only by trailing whitespace/case will dedup due to .strip().lower() — acceptable.

update_client deletes+reinserts the clients doc instead of update_one; preserves created_at/created_by via prev. Minor: if build_clients runs between delete and insert in a highly concurrent env, a request could momentarily see the client missing. Non-blocking for single-admin studio use.
Edit propagation uses bookings._id $in ids to update client_name/client_phone on every booking tied to the old key — verified via booking detail refetch after edit. Good.

Frontend clients.tsx conditionally renders Tambah via isAdmin only — matches backend ADMIN gate. The entire 'Database Klien' tile is hidden from staff in Lainnya (observed), which is stricter than spec but acceptable since staff never had the viewer role anyway (allowed = can('booking') || can('reports')).
client-form.tsx uses router.replace after save so back-navigation goes to the clients list, not the form — good UX.
